Vegan Fajitas

posted by carleigh on August 26, 2026 0 comments »
Jump to Recipe

These easy vegan fajitas are the kind of dinner you can throw together when you want something flavorful without spending your entire evening in the kitchen. Smoky seasoned vegan steak and colorful peppers cook together on one sheet pan, then get served in warm tortillas with all your favorite toppings.

If you love filling meals with minimal effort, you need a copy of PLANTYOU QUICKIES! I promise that this cookbook will make your life a thousand times easier. It is chock-full of recipes that take less time yet taste amazing. Well, what are you waiting for?

Why You’ll Love This Recipe

  • Everything cooks together on a single sheet pan, so cleanup is minimal. This also means that most of the cooking process is hands-off!
  • Ready in just over 30 minutes, perfect for a low-effort dinner that doesn’t require a lot of planning ahead.
  • This recipe is super colorful and flavorful thanks to three different bell peppers, red onion, and a smoky fajita spice blend.
  • This recipe is great for feeding a crowd because everyone can assemble their own fajitas with their favorite toppings. Even your non-vegan guests will love these vegan fajitas!
  • Easy to scale up and customize based on the size of your household and everyone’s preferences.

Key Ingredients

  • Vegan steak is the protein component. I used Beyond, but there are plenty of plant-based options that work here, including tofu.
  • Bell peppers (green, orange, and red) are the central component of fajitas! Peppers add plenty of color and a combination of sweet and slightly bitter flavors.
  • Fajita seasoning is a combination of spices that marries the vegetables and vegan meat together.
  • Small tortillas act as the perfect vehicle for enjoying the bell pepper and vegan steak fajita filling.

Hack It!

  • If you can’t find or afford vegan steak, use your favorite plant protein options. Extra-firm tofu cut into strips works really well. Press it first for a firmer, crispy texture.
  • Use whatever combination of bell peppers you have on hand if you don’t have a variety of colors. You can even add sliced zucchini or mushrooms.
  • Make your own seasoning using the spice blend listed in the recipe card, or use a store-bought fajita seasoning packet for convenience.
  • Turn this into a fajita bowl by serving the roasted mixture over rice or quinoa instead of tortillas.
  • Load up the toppings with avocado, guacamole, pickled onions, jalapeños, salsa, vegan cheese, or fresh cilantro.
  • Swap flour tortillas for corn tortillas if you need this recipe to accommodate a gluten-free diet.

How to Make Vegan Fajitas

Step 1: Preheat the oven to 400F. On a metal sheet pan, add the bell peppers, onion, and vegan steak.

Step 2: Drizzle with olive oil, then coat with the fajita seasoning. Stir well until everything is thoroughly mixed.

Step 3: Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes, until the vegan meat is cooked through and the vegetables are soft.

Step 4: Serve with soft tortillas, vegan sour cream, lime, salsa and cilantro, as desired.

Frequently Asked Questions

Can I use frozen vegetables?

Yes, although fresh peppers and onions will give you the best roasted texture. If using frozen vegetables, you may need to add a few extra minutes of cooking time.

Are these vegan fajitas meal prep friendly?

Yes! The roasted filling can be prepared ahead and stored in the refrigerator for up to 4 days. Reheat it in a skillet or oven before serving.

Is this fajita filling freezer friendly?

Yes. Freeze the cooked filling in an airtight container for up to 2 months. The peppers will be softer after thawing, but they’ll still work well in fajitas or bowls.

The Recipe: Vegan Fajitas

Extremely easy and vibrant vegan fajitas, served in soft tortillas with your favorite toppings.
No ratings yet
Print Recipe Pin Recipe Leave a Review
Servings: 4
Prep Time: 10 minutes mins
Cook Time: 30 minutes mins
Total Time: 40 minutes mins

Ingredients

  • 2 cups vegan steak or protein of choice, I used Beyond Steak but strips of extra firm tofu work as well
  • 1 green pepper, sliced
  • 1 orange pepper, sliced
  • 1 red pepper, sliced
  • 1 red onion, sliced
  • 1 tsp olive oil
  • 1 pack fajita seasoning

OR homemade fajita mix

  • 2 tbsp paprika
  • 1½ tbsp garlic powder
  • 1½ tbsp oregano
  • 1 tbsp cumin
  • 1 tsp chili powder
  • ½ tsp salt

To serve

  • 8-10 6-inch tortillas
  • Vegan sour cream
  • limes, cut into wedges
  • salsa
  • cilantro

Equipment

  • Cutting board
  • Sharp knife
  • Sheet pan
  • Parchment Paper or reusable silicone sheet

Instructions 

  • Preheat the oven to 400F.
  • On a metal sheet pan, add the bell peppers, onion, and vegan steak. Drizzle with olive oil, then coat with the fajita seasoning. Stir well until everything is thoroughly mixed.
  • Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake for 25 to 30 minutes, until the vegan meat is cooked through and the vegetables are soft.
  • Serve with the tortillas, vegan sour cream, lime, salsa and cilantro, as desired.

Notes

  • If you can’t find or afford vegan steak, use your favorite plant protein options. Extra-firm tofu cut into strips works really well. Press it first for a firmer, crispy texture.
  • Use whatever combination of bell peppers you have on hand if you don’t have a variety of colors. You can even add sliced zucchini or mushrooms.
  • Make your own seasoning using the spice blend listed in the recipe card, or use a store-bought fajita seasoning packet for convenience.
  • Turn this into a fajita bowl by serving the roasted mixture over rice or quinoa instead of tortillas.
  • Load up the toppings with avocado, guacamole, pickled onions, jalapeños, salsa, vegan cheese, or fresh cilantro.
  • Swap flour tortillas for corn tortillas if you need this recipe to accommodate a gluten-free diet.
